logloss_theorem: Correct certificate never lowers its same-readout true-class mass; clipped/unclipped finite NLL cannot increase.
limitations: Conditional on actual certificate correctness; not a source/parser soundness proof.
Different-context raw distributions have no transposition nonregression guarantee.
False certificate can leave proper scores unchanged when truth is outside exchanged pair; hard accuracy gates remain necessary.
Exact mass ties can alter derived hard decisions without changing probabilities; preserve the supplied original raw-logit winner on abstention/agreement.
Derived hybrid vectors are mass permutations, not unchanged rawT1 forecasts or statistically calibrated posterior probabilities.
